blocks.content: Now that everything is set up, here's how you can approach the styling process:

items: Container and Card Layout: Center the card on the page and give it a modern look with rounded corners and a shadow. Make sure the design is responsive.
Image Styling: Adjust the profile image within the card to fit nicely.
Content Styling: Style the text, including the name, job title, and company link.
Chips and Buttons: Design the "expertise badges" (chips) and action buttons with hover effects for interactivity.
